reason: The final 'By def-maincb-raw-call' packaging is ill-typed. That definition requires a literal output level-one map together with its single fixed amplification family; lem-maincb-cross-class-merging-datum supplies only an amplified four-corner datum containing four corner maps, not a designated literal output map. The raw-call definition permits a post-helper datum scale but has no field for inserting the whole four-corner datum. Node 1.3.3 neither constructs nor identifies the required single output map (nor shows how four map families satisfy that singular field), so the cited external conclusion does not by itself yield the asserted Stage-3 raw-call datum.
